review_scope: Independent private early source, visual benefit, original native/STL exact mapping and complete-face finite-domain review; not a final colored artifact, construction reconstruction, print certificate or publication approval.
original_mesh_method: Read the binary STL triangle records without reordering; calculate cross-product normals and areas from actual vertices.
Open the original native scene read-only in Blender, verify one mesh/all triangles/one material/all material indices zero, then export coordinates only to private reviewer data.
Check an oriented cyclic exact-coordinate bijection between all native and canonical STL triangles; check scout selected native-to-canonical mappings separately.
Recompute the selected set with all three vertices on each individually bounded support plane; no centroid-only or global bounding-box selection.
Verify original materialized bytes, Git blob SHA-1 and the fixed commit paths read-only.
delivery_gate_if_parent_assigns_builder: Materialize and hash the entire original model package, not only the limited research subset. Preserve original STL bytes, all triangle coordinates and order, existing geometry and identity.

Recompute canonical-to-native and canonical-to-3MF mappings. Independently verify every 3MF triangle coordinate and order, all material corners and all nonselected faces neutral; never paste native polygon IDs as STL IDs.
Use only whole original triangles satisfying the stated finite all-vertex domains. Do not cut triangles, add geometry or repaint mixed/unseen materials to increase the color area.

Produce five final previews and a same-camera/settings neutral comparison from the final deliverable. Reassess actual visual benefit and any misleading isolated color boundaries; this source judgment does not force final PASS.
Verify editable Blender/3MF by genuine vertex/material change, save and reopen, plus independent clean reconstruction; freeze exact final core and PNG hashes before final independent review.

Include final independent QA in checksums and actual ZIP members, verify bytes/CRC/checksum closure. Keep source photographs, downloaded pages and private research copies out of the public model package unless separately authorized.

Keep original geometric approximations, source dates and printing limitations explicit. A material-only change does not validate uncertain shape, structural performance or real print success. No automatic school-count increase or homepage representative replacement.
input_stage_note: The early note is a frozen research input, including its pending-review wording. This independent decision supplies the review result; it does not retroactively make the private probes final deliverables.

identity.canonical_root: 國立政治大學/山下校區/buildings/nccu-jingtang

decision.priority_relative_to_other_reviewed_cand: Stronger and more spatially continuous than the Yukang central-window-only candidate; still not a whole-building color reconstruction.
decision.summary: 兩張官方原照支持凹弧庭院白色牆／柱及灰色雨棚垂直邊。相同相機與光照的中性比較顯示前庭不透明白面連續性有真收益，未靠補深玻璃或未知屋頂增色；後面與頂面幾乎不變是正確的證據限域，不應隱瞞。

personally_viewed.finding: 完整 1920×1080 正面；中央及右側四層弧牆、白色立柱和窗間不透明面清楚。左側受樹遮，窗內反射／簾影不同，不支持全部凹窗背一律上玻璃色。
640×427 左斜近照補白色柱側與牆面，灰色入口雨棚垂直邊可辨。實物雨棚為弧形，既有模型方板簡化不能因配色被宣稱已修復。
原 mono 預覽僅供歷史形體參考；其光照與研究 probe 不完全相同，不單用此圖作色彩收益判斷。
前庭白色不透明牆／柱與仍中性的窗背可區分；大屋頂與外背弧保持中性。
反向斜視仍僅前庭選定面受色，側端及大屋頂未被擴染。
正立面白面連續性最清楚；少數未切出的細白框／窗背保持中性，不為視覺完整擴塗。
外背弧、背突出部和屋頂仍中性；沒有背面來源支持全面白色。
頂視屋頂占主面積，只有前庭的受證立面局部可見；不可把此圖稱全樓配色收益。
獨立由相同 probe 匯入、相機、WORKBENCH 光照與設定渲染全部 material index 0；與 probe-front 直接比較，庭院白面對比可辨。
同條件中性正立面對照確認白牆／柱的改善不是僅換相機或打光；未儲存原 scene。

approved_finite_scope.arc_walls: C=(0,-28); 80 inner chord segments, theta=(i+0.5)*pi/80; all vertices satisfy dot(v.xy-C,u)=43*cos(pi/160), |dot(v.xy-C,t)|<=43*sin(pi/160), z in [2.8,57], eps=0.0003 mm, actual inward horizontal normal.
approved_finite_scope.piers: Angles 2..179 step 13 degrees; radial [40.45,44.95], tangent [-1.25,1.25], z [3,57]. Only the inner front r=40.45 and side t=+/-1.25 planes, all three points bounded and actual vertical normals.
approved_finite_scope.canopy_fascia: x [-11.5,11.5], y [1.5,14.5], z [13.5,15.3]; only front y=1.5 and two end x=+/-11.5 planes with outward normals. Top and underside excluded.
approved_finite_scope.source_indices: selection.json canonical STL IDs and native-canonical-map.json must be revalidated against the delivered original STL. reviewer-independent-scope.json records all recomputed segment groups.
approved_finite_scope.additional_tangent_constraint_result: The initially omitted finite tangential bounds were independently added and produce exactly the same 1029 arc-wall faces and final 1395 white faces. Scout probe.py now contains the bound; existing selection/PNG sets did not change.
approved_finite_scope.excluded: Window backs/reveals/fine frames, canopy top/underside, roof and roof lip, outer curved rear facade, end walls, rear protrusions, base and any mixed/unseen surfaces remain neutral.

source_limits: The two full JPEGs were decoded independently. EXIF root/nested DateTime, Original, Digitized and offset fields are absent; no XMP packet/date attributes found. Capture year is unknown.
1975 start, 1976 completion and 2004 renovation are building events, not photograph dates. Do not imply 2026 current colors.

The official library-memory page is the source context; direct HTML retrieval was truncated and file-description/history pages were not accessible. No claim of reading an unavailable file history or determining upload/capture time.
The source supports white/light ceramic surface and gray fascia color families, not calibrated paint codes. Surface dirt, dark drip marks, shade and weathering are not new segmented materials.

The old model has coarse window divisions, a simplified rectangular canopy and unverified roof/back form. This material-only candidate cannot claim to correct those shapes. Repeated material across the photographed curved frontage is a bounded proxy, not measured restoration.

scout_manifest_validation.result: All listed current bytes and SHA-256 matched before this report. The manifest is intentionally not embedded as a recursive binding; it may later include this report.
